Package io.mavlink4j.config

Record Class MavlinkSettings

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.mavlink4j.config.MavlinkSettings
public record MavlinkSettings(Duration heartbeatPeriod, Duration peerTimeout, Duration commandTimeout, int commandRetries, int commandMaxInProgressExtensions, MavlinkSettings.Rc rc, Duration closeJoinTimeout, int maxResyncBuffers, int dispatchQueueCapacity, Duration pollTimeout, int txPoolSize, MavlinkSettings.Parameter parameter, MavlinkSettings.SigningSettings signing, MavlinkSettings.LinkHealth linkHealth, MavlinkSettings.PeerSettings peer, InstantSource clock, ThreadFactory threadFactory, Executor callbackExecutor) extends Record
Every value the MAVLink spec itself declines to pin (heartbeat rate, peer timeout, command retry policy, ...), the module's own internal bounds (resync buffer cap, dispatch queue capacity, poll interval, scheduler pool size) and the three runtime collaborators the library must never hard-wire: the clock, the thread factory and the executor completions are delivered on. One framework-free record — no System.getenv, no System.getProperty, no Spring anywhere in this module.

Build one with builder() (every field starts at its default) or derive one from an existing instance with toBuilder(); defaults() is builder().build().

Runtime collaborators

  • clock() — the only source of "now" in the library. Transports stamp nothing; the codec stamps Frame.receivedAt from this clock, so a test advances time by hand.
  • threadFactory() — every thread the library starts (a reader per link, the TX scheduler pool, one drain thread per async subscriber) comes from it. The library names the thread it receives and marks it daemon; the factory chooses the kind (a Java 21 host may pass Thread.ofVirtual().factory()).
  • callbackExecutor() — where a future handed out by the library is completed, hence where its dependent continuations run. The default runs them directly on the completing thread (the reader thread, or the timer that fired a timeout); never null.

    MavlinkSettings.Builder
    Mutable, single-use staging area for a MavlinkSettings; validation happens in MavlinkSettings.Builder.build().
    static final record 
    MavlinkSettings.LinkHealth
    DefaultLinkHealth's drop-rate accounting: loss is measured over the trailing window only (a restart or a second sender must not haunt the rate forever), and a wrapped seq gap larger than resyncGap is a sender restart / second source, not that many lost frames -- it is counted as one resync and adds no loss.
    static final record 
    MavlinkSettings.Parameter
    Parameter read/write timing.
    static final record 
    MavlinkSettings.PeerSettings
    Address-flap detection in the peer directory: a peer heard from two addresses on one link within flapWindow is flagged, and the warning for one peer is repeated at most once per warnInterval so a genuine roam cannot flood the log.
    static final record 
    MavlinkSettings.Rc
    The fixed-rate RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE relay's cadence.
    static final record 
    MavlinkSettings.SigningSettings
    Pure numeric signing tuning -- windows, a tolerance, a bound.
